person_note: The controlling narrative is third person, with sustained external narration focalized through Katie, Alex, and Kevin. The Goodreads sample repeatedly exposes that base voice across interior scenes, and it agrees with the authorized opening excerpt and explicit whole-book POV descriptions. Apparent first-person counterexamples are character dialogue or Carly's embedded letters; Katie's third-person account of an abused “friend” is also spoken subterfuge. These local voices do not form autonomous base sections, so the book is THIRD rather than ALTERNATING. No credible contrary structural evidence remains. Quote audit: q02158 and q02197 remain locally unmarked rather than borrowing the book-level THIRD label.
